scope: ILLUSTRATIVE Cloudflare Workers PAID, R2 Standard, Queues and D1 global list prices from dated first-party docs; taxes, contract, plans, region and extras excluded

r2_standard.billing_rounding_note: Official provider rounds usage up to next billing unit; estimator gives continuous approximation. Real invoice may be higher due to billing increments and daily sampling.

unpriced_external: Do not assume zero for CPU containers, GPUs, AI tokens, paid CDN outside provider free static assets, outbound third-party data, support, developer time, taxes or enterprise contracts. Scenarios must explicitly provide numbers, or estimator emits UNKNOWN.
